nodes.description: address public gameOwner; privileged owner set to msg.sender in constructor and used for access control in mintMonster, setAllowed, setters and payout.
uint public mintCost (20) used to compute minimum token deposit in createMonster and settable by owner.
uint public levelCost (10) used to compute minimum token deposit in levelMonster and settable by owner.
uint public luckModifier (30) used as modulus in lucky() to derive battle luck multiplier.
uint public losingBoost (2) added to the loser's stats after a battle.
uint public fairLevelBoost (3) used to compute fairLevel/fairDefense thresholds in battle.
uint public statLuck (7) used as modulus in random() to derive per-battle stat boosts.
Monster[] public monsters; storage array of creatures, read in battle/levelMonster and pushed to in mintMonster/createMonster.
mapping(address=>bool) public allowed; whitelist of ERC20 tokens accepted by createMonster and levelMonster.
uint private winner; records winning monster id during battle.
uint private loser; records losing monster id during battle.
battle(uint _attackingMonster) external payable onlyOwnerOf: computes pseudo-random luck, selects defender, mutates monster stats and pays ETH to msg.sender or to the defender address cast.
mintMonster(string _name, address _to) public: owner-only free mint that pushes a new Monster and safe-mints an NFT.
createMonster(string _name, address _to, address _token, uint256 amount) public: validates whitelisted token and minimum deposit, mints a monster and pulls tokens via transferFrom.
levelMonster(uint _monsterId, address _token, uint256 amount) public: validates token and deposit, adds a random boost to a monster and pulls tokens via transferFrom.
setAllowed(address token, bool allow) public owner-only: whitelists/unwhitelists an ERC20 token.
setMintCost(uint _mintCost) public owner-only: updates mintCost.
setLevelCost(uint _levelCost) public owner-only: updates levelCost.
setLuckModifier(uint _luckMod) public owner-only: updates luckModifier.
setLosingBoost(uint _losingBoost) public owner-only: updates losingBoost.
setLevelBoost(uint _levelBoost) public owner-only: updates fairLevelBoost.
setStatLuck(uint _statLuck) public owner-only: updates statLuck.
payout() public owner-only: transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
deposit() public payable: accepts ETH into the pool used for battle payouts.
random(uint restriction) private view: derives a value from keccak256(block.timestamp*difficulty*number*restriction) % statLuck + 1.
lucky(uint restriction) private view: derives a luck value from block variables modulo luckModifier.
findBattle(uint restriction) private view: derives a defender index from block variables modulo monsters.length.
totalSupply() public view: returns monsters.length.
maxBet() public view: returns 0.5% of the contract balance.
modifier onlyOwnerOf(uint _monsterId): requires ownerOf(_monsterId) == msg.sender and gates battle.
constructor(): initializes gameOwner, luckModifier, losingBoost, fairLevelBoost, mintCost, levelCost and statLuck.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, owner checks and ETH transfers.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable value used as randomness entropy in random/lucky/findBattle.
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value * 2) inside battle when the attacker wins: external ETH send performed after state mutation of monster stats.
defenderWin.transfer(msg.value / 1000 * 300) inside battle: external ETH send to address(uint160(_defendingMonster)).
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) inside payout: drains the whole pool balance to the game owner.
IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) inside createMonster: external token pull from an arbitrary whitelisted token contract.
IERC20(_token).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) inside levelMonster: external token pull from an arbitrary whitelisted token contract.
Pseudo-randomness derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty/block.number in random, lucky and findBattle, which is miner-manipulable.
uint _attackingMonster parameter of battle.
uint luck local in battle, assigned from lucky(11).
uint _defendingMonster local in battle, assigned from findBattle(luck).
uint attackAmount local in battle (attacker.attackPower + attacker.magicPower).
uint defenseAmount local in battle (defender.defensePower + defender.magicResist).
uint fairLevel local in battle (defender.level + fairLevelBoost).
uint fairDefense local in battle (defender.level - fairLevelBoost).
string _name parameter of mintMonster.
address _to parameter of mintMonster.
uint id local in mintMonster (monsters.length).
string _name parameter of createMonster.
address _to parameter of createMonster.
address _token parameter of createMonster, used for whitelist check and transferFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of createMonster, used for minimum check and transferFrom.
uint id local in createMonster (monsters.length).
uint _monsterId parameter of levelMonster, indexing into monsters.
address _token parameter of levelMonster, used for whitelist check and transferFrom.
uint256 amount parameter of levelMonster, used for minimum check and transferFrom.
Monster storage _levelMonster local in levelMonster.
uint Boost local in levelMonster, assigned from random(7).
address token parameter of setAllowed.
bool allow parameter of setAllowed.
uint _mintCost parameter of setMintCost.
uint _levelCost parameter of setLevelCost.
uint _luckMod parameter of setLuckModifier.
uint _losingBoost parameter of setLosingBoost.
uint _levelBoost parameter of setLevelBoost.
uint _statLuck parameter of setStatLuck.
uint restriction parameter of random.
uint restriction parameter of lucky.
uint restriction parameter of findBattle.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns gameOwner = msg.sender, establishing privileged state.
Constructor initializes luckModifier used by the pseudo-random luck function.
Constructor initializes fairLevelBoost used by battle thresholds.
Constructor initializes statLuck used as modulus in random().
onlyOwnerOf compares ownerOf(_monsterId) with the caller-supplied msg.sender.
The onlyOwnerOf modifier gate controls entry into battle.
msg.sender determines battle authorization and receives the ETH payout.
mintMonster requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setAllowed requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setMintCost requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setLevelCost requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setLuckModifier requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setLosingBoost requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setLevelBoost requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
setStatLuck requires msg.sender == gameOwner.
payout requires msg.sender == gameOwner before draining the balance.
random() uses block.timestamp as entropy, making the result miner-influenceable.
lucky() uses block.timestamp as entropy, making the luck value miner-influenceable.
findBattle() uses block.timestamp as entropy to select the defending monster.
block.timestamp feeds the timestamp-based pseudo-randomness unsafe operation.
battle consumes lucky(11) output as the luck multiplier of attack/defense amounts.
battle consumes findBattle(luck) output to pick the defending monster index.
battle assigns attackBoost/defenseBoost/magicBoost/resistBoost from random().
levelMonster assigns Boost = random(7) to the leveled monster stats.
Battle outcome depends entirely on the timestamp-seeded randomness.
Attacker-win branch executes msg.sender.transfer(msg.value * 2) after mutating monster stats.
Defender-win branch executes defenderWin.transfer(msg.value / 1000 * 300) after mutating monster stats.
payout transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
createMonster performs an external ERC20 transferFrom on a caller-supplied token address.
levelMonster performs an external ERC20 transferFrom on a caller-supplied token address.
Payout recipient of the winning transfer is the untrusted msg.sender.
payout sends the whole balance to the caller-checked msg.sender address.
createMonster checks allowed[_token] before accepting deposits.
levelMonster checks allowed[_token] before accepting deposits.
createMonster enforces amount >= mintCost * 10**18.
levelMonster enforces amount >= levelCost * 10**18.
battle reads and mutates Monster entries in the monsters array.
createMonster pushes a new Monster and mints with id = monsters.length.
levelMonster loads monsters[_monsterId] into storage.
payout authorization depends on the gameOwner state variable.
ETH transfer to msg.sender hands control to an arbitrary caller contract before battle state is fully settled.
ETH transfer to the defender-derived address invokes arbitrary recipient code (fallback) mid-battle.
payout ETH transfer to the owner address invokes arbitrary recipient code.
transferFrom on a whitelisted ERC20 hands control to arbitrary token contract code.
